notes: Classic buyer ISO blast broadcasting a client's purchase criteria to the broker network. shouldExtractParty=true; address should be null (buyer is looking, not selling). Criteria (neighborhoods, beds, budget) fold onto the opportunity row.

input.subject: ISO: 3BR condo UWS for qualified buyer, up to $3.2M
input.bodyText:
Hi everyone,

I have a well-qualified, pre-approved buyer actively looking on the Upper West Side. Sharing their criteria in case you have something coming soon or off-market:

- 3 bed / 2 bath minimum
- Condo or condop (no co-ops - they want flexibility to sublet)
- Budget up to $3.2M
- Doorman + elevator, in-unit W/D a big plus
- Below 96th St, ideally near the park
- Closing flexible, all cash available

Must-have: real second bath. Dealbreaker: walk-up.

Please send anything that fits - happy to co-broke.

Dana Kessler
Douglas Elliman
